> **Verdict: Mixed: skill + luck** · Confidence: High · Injury overlap: No

Gavin Williams did not actually pitch worse in 2026; his ERA rise from 3.06 to 3.76 over 184.3 IP (up from 167.7 IP in 2025) was driven by BABIP regression and poor runner timing rather than a drop in performance [Q5, Q15, Q16]. Underneath the inflated ERA, Williams made a substantial skill leap: his FIP dropped from 4.39 to 3.48, his strikeout rate jumped from 24.6% to 33.2% (z = 3.7), and his walk rate dropped from 11.8% to 8.2% (z = -2.3) [Q4, Q5, Q7]. His results in 2025 were masked by a suppressed .254 BABIP despite a .323 xwOBA [Q4]. In 2026, his expected outcomes improved to a .301 xwOBA, but his BABIP normalized to .288, and damage clustered heavily with runners on base [Q4, Q7].

## What changed in the pitches

Williams restructured his pitch mix in 2026, reducing four-seam fastball usage from 37.3% to 27.3% and making his sweeper his primary offering at 28.8% usage (852 pitches) [Q6]. His primary four-seamer gained velocity, rising from 96.6 to 97.6 mph (z = 4.7), which increased its whiff rate from 23.4% to 31.8% and reduced opponent xwOBA from .383 to .301 [Q6, Q7]. Four-seam home runs allowed dropped from 12 in 2025 to 5 in 2026 [Q22]. 

The elevated home run overall total (28 in 2026 vs. 23 in 2025) came from contact degradation on his secondary pitches [Q4, Q22]:
* **Knuckle Curve:** HRs allowed jumped from 2 to 8, as opponent hard-hit rate surged from 33.3% to 49.0% and slugging rose from .181 to .396 [Q22].
* **Sinker:** Usage more than doubled from 6.6% to 15.6% [Q6]. While its CSW% improved from 30.7% to 34.9%, it remained vulnerable to damage, allowing 6 HRs (up from 1) with a 62.5% hard-hit rate and a .547 slugging percentage [Q6, Q22].
* **Sweeper:** Averaged 87.5 mph (+1.0 mph) and 11.3 inches of horizontal break (+1.3 in), holding hitters to a .230 xwOBA and generating a 44.0% whiff rate [Q6].

## Skill vs. luck

Williams' missed bats and zone control reached true talent growth across the board:
* **Whiff Rate:** Rose from 27.7% to 32.8% (z = 3.0) [Q4, Q7].
* **Chase Rate:** Expanded from 26.1% to 33.6% (z = 4.5) [Q7].
* **CSW Rate:** Grew from 28.5% to 33.5% (z = 4.1) [Q4, Q7].

Despite allowing fewer total baserunners in 2026 (183 baserunners: 116 hits, 61 BB, 6 HBP) than in 2025 (193 baserunners: 107 hits, 83 BB, 3 HBP), he surrendered 77 earned runs in 2026 compared to 57 in 2025 [Q5, Q13]. This gap was caused by bad sequencing and home run leverage [Q11, Q13]. Solo home runs remained flat (16 in 2025 vs. 17 in 2026), but multi-run home runs increased from 7 to 11, accounting for 41 runs allowed on home runs alone [Q11]. Williams' HR/FB rate rose from 19.3% to 25.5% [Q4].

## Health and workload

Williams suffered no injuries or roster moves during 2025 or 2026 [Q14]. His only career IL stint was a 97-day placement for right elbow inflammation in 2024 [Q14]. 

Far from tiring late in 2026, his velocity and bat-missing ability accelerated in the second half [Q21]. Fastball velocity increased from 96.8 mph in March–June (17 starts) to 98.3 mph in July–September (15 starts) (z = 6.4) [Q21]. Over that same stretch, his strikeout rate jumped from 28.3% to 39.5% (z = 3.2) while maintaining an 8.1% walk rate, dropping his xwOBA from .329 to .268 [Q21].

## What the data can't tell us

* Statcast pitch-level data does not contain official earned vs. unearned run tagging by inning, leaving exact strand rates and monthly ERA splits unavailable.
* Team defensive metrics (OAA, DRS) are not included, making it impossible to separate field-behind-the-pitcher movement from true hit distribution on balls in play.
* Medical records cannot reveal whether pitch location misfires on the sinker and knuckle curve stemmed from physical mechanical variation or pitch-calling strategy.

## Next questions

* Did the location chart of Williams' knuckle curve change in 2026 to explain the jump in hard-hit rate from 33.3% to 49.0%?
* How did Williams' performance vary by pitch count or inning through the order across his 32 starts in 2026?
* Will the Guardians adjust his sinker usage moving forward given its high .416 xwOBA and .547 opponent slugging percentage?

SELECT
    season,
    pitch_type,
    COUNT(*) AS pitches,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN events = 'home_run' THEN 1 END) AS hr,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN type = 'X' THEN 1 END) AS batted_balls,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN type = 'X' AND launch_speed >= 95 THEN 1 END) AS hard_hits,
    ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN type = 'X' AND launch_speed >= 95 THEN 1 END)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN type = 'X' THEN 1 END), 0), 4) AS hard_hit_pct,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN events IN ('single', 'double', 'triple', 'home_run', 'field_out', 'strikeout', 'strikeout_double_play', 'grounded_into_double_play', 'fielders_choice', 'fielders_choice_out', 'double_play', 'triple_play', 'force_out') THEN 1 END) AS ab,
    SUM(CASE 
        WHEN events = 'single' THEN 1
        WHEN events = 'double' THEN 2
        WHEN events = 'triple' THEN 3
        WHEN events = 'home_run' THEN 4
        ELSE 0 
    END) AS total_bases,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE 
        WHEN events = 'single' THEN 1
        WHEN events = 'double' THEN 2
        WHEN events = 'triple' THEN 3
        WHEN events = 'home_run' THEN 4
        ELSE 0 
    END)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN events IN ('single', 'double', 'triple', 'home_run', 'field_out', 'strikeout', 'strikeout_double_play', 'grounded_into_double_play', 'fielders_choice', 'fielders_choice_out', 'double_play', 'triple_play', 'force_out') THEN 1 END), 0), 4) AS slg
FROM pitches
WHERE pitcher = 668909 AND season IN (2025, 2026)
GROUP BY season, pitch_type
ORDER BY season, pitches DESC;

WITH p AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN game_date BETWEEN ?::DATE AND ?::DATE THEN 'A' ELSE 'B' END AS period
               FROM pitches
               WHERE pitcher = ? AND (game_date BETWEEN ?::DATE AND ?::DATE OR game_date BETWEEN ?::DATE AND ?::DATE)),
    long AS (SELECT 'k_pct' AS stat, period, CAST((events IN ('strikeout','strikeout_double_play')) AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM p WHERE (events IS NOT NULL AND events NOT IN
        ('caught_stealing_2b','caught_stealing_3b','caught_stealing_home',
         'pickoff_1b','pickoff_2b','pickoff_3b',
         'pickoff_caught_stealing_2b','pickoff_caught_stealing_3b','pickoff_caught_stealing_home',
         'stolen_base_2b','stolen_base_3b','stolen_base_home','wild_pitch','passed_ball',
         'other_advance','truncated_pa'))
        UNION ALL SELECT 'bb_pct' AS stat, period, CAST((events IN ('walk','intent_walk')) AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM p WHERE (events IS NOT NULL AND events NOT IN
        ('caught_stealing_2b','caught_stealing_3b','caught_stealing_home',
         'pickoff_1b','pickoff_2b','pickoff_3b',
         'pickoff_caught_stealing_2b','pickoff_caught_stealing_3b','pickoff_caught_stealing_home',
         'stolen_base_2b','stolen_base_3b','stolen_base_home','wild_pitch','passed_ball',
         'other_advance','truncated_pa'))
        UNION ALL SELECT 'hr_per_bf' AS stat, period, CAST((events = 'home_run') AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM p WHERE (events IS NOT NULL AND events NOT IN
        ('caught_stealing_2b','caught_stealing_3b','caught_stealing_home',
         'pickoff_1b','pickoff_2b','pickoff_3b',
         'pickoff_caught_stealing_2b','pickoff_caught_stealing_3b','pickoff_caught_stealing_home',
         'stolen_base_2b','stolen_base_3b','stolen_base_home','wild_pitch','passed_ball',
         'other_advance','truncated_pa'))
        UNION ALL SELECT 'whiff_pct' AS stat, period, CAST((is_whiff) AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM p WHERE is_swing
        UNION ALL SELECT 'chase_pct' AS stat, period, CAST((is_chase) AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM p WHERE zone BETWEEN 11 AND 14
        UNION ALL SELECT 'zone_pct' AS stat, period, CAST((in_zone) AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM p WHERE TRUE
        UNION ALL SELECT 'csw_pct' AS stat, period, CAST((is_csw) AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM p WHERE TRUE
        UNION ALL SELECT 'xwoba' AS stat, period, CAST((CASE WHEN woba_denom = 1 THEN

Q11.purpose: Gavin Williams HR type and base context 2025 vs 2026

SELECT 
  season,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN events = 'home_run' THEN 1 END) as total_hr,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN events = 'home_run' AND on_1b IS NULL AND on_2b IS NULL AND on_3b IS NULL THEN 1 END) as solo_hr,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN events = 'home_run' AND (on_1b IS NOT NULL OR on_2b IS NOT NULL OR on_3b IS NOT NULL) THEN 1 END) as multirun_hr,
  SUM(CASE WHEN events = 'home_run' THEN 1 + CASE WHEN on_1b IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN on_2b IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN on_3b IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END) as total_hr_runs

GROUP BY season
ORDER BY season

    games AS (SELECT period, game_pk, avg(release_speed) AS v, count(*) AS c FROM p
              WHERE release_speed IS NOT NULL AND pitch_type = (SELECT pitch_type FROM pitches WHERE pitcher = 668909 AND pitch_type IN ('FF', 'SI', 'FC') GROUP BY pitch_type ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1) GROUP BY period, game_pk),
    s AS (SELECT stat, period, avg(v) AS mean, coalesce(var_samp(v), 0) AS variance, count(v) AS n
          FROM long GROUP BY stat, period
          UNION ALL
          
          SELECT 'main_fb_velo', period, sum(v * c) / sum(c), coalesce(var_samp(v), 0), count(*) FROM games GROUP BY period)
    SELECT a.stat, a.mean AS period_a, b.mean AS period_b, b.mean - a.mean AS change, a.n AS n_a, b.n AS n_b,
           round((b.mean - a.mean) / nullif(sqrt(a.variance / a.n + b.variance / b.n), 0), 1) AS z
    FROM s a JOIN s b ON a.stat = b.stat AND a.period = 'A' AND b.period = 'B'
    ORDER BY abs(z) DESC NULLS LAST

Q22.purpose: Gavin Williams 2025 vs 2026 HR, hard hit pct, and SLG by pitch type
Q22.sql:
SELECT
    season,
    pitch_type,
    COUNT(*) AS pitches,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN events = 'home_run' THEN 1 END) AS hr,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN type = 'X' THEN 1 END) AS batted_balls,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN type = 'X' AND launch_speed >= 95 THEN 1 END) AS hard_hits,
    ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN type = 'X' AND launch_speed >= 95 THEN 1 END)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN type = 'X' THEN 1 END), 0), 4) AS hard_hit_pct,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN events IN ('single', 'double', 'triple', 'home_run', 'field_out', 'strikeout', 'strikeout_double_play', 'grounded_into_double_play', 'fielders_choice', 'fielders_choice_out', 'double_play', 'triple_play', 'force_out') THEN 1 END) AS ab,
    SUM(CASE 
        WHEN events = 'single' THEN 1
        WHEN events = 'double' THEN 2
        WHEN events = 'triple' THEN 3
        WHEN events = 'home_run' THEN 4
        ELSE 0 
    END) AS total_bases,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE 
        WHEN events = 'single' THEN 1
        WHEN events = 'double' THEN 2
        WHEN events = 'triple' THEN 3
        WHEN events = 'home_run' THEN 4
        ELSE 0 
    END)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN events IN ('single', 'double', 'triple', 'home_run', 'field_out', 'strikeout', 'strikeout_double_play', 'grounded_into_double_play', 'fielders_choice', 'fielders_choice_out', 'double_play', 'triple_play', 'force_out') THEN 1 END), 0), 4) AS slg
FROM pitches
WHERE pitcher = 668909 AND season IN (2025, 2026)
GROUP BY season, pitch_type
ORDER BY season, pitches DESC
